pr_title: Add a configuration option to set a tablet as a relative input
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/swaywm/sway/issues/4139.

This commit adds a new option to set whether movement of a tablet tool should be treated as absolute or relative; the default is absolute.

Configuration is per-tool, with pen/eraser/brush/pencil/airbrush tools being independently configurable. Mouse and lens tools ignore this setting and are always treated as relative.

Included is a change to switch lens tool input to relative. I don't have such a device to test this, but [the libinput docs](https://wayland.freedesktop.org/libinput/doc/1.11.3/tablet-support.html#tablet-relative-motion) recommend having it as relative by default.

Tested with the pen tool, since that's all I have :)
pr_comments: Not sure what kind of testing this patch is still waiting for, but building and running it just now gives the expected functionality with my XP-PEN tablet (though only on @Xyene 's branch, which is a bit out of date). Only the config option in conjunction with a wildcard to select all tool modes does not work in my shell (zsh), though '*' does work with quotes (single and double). If you'd like me to do any additional testing let me know :)

issue_context.title: Add a configuration option to set a tablet as a relative input
issue_context.body:
I have a Wacom intuos M Bluetooth, and i like using it as a relative input.
I haven't view any sway configuration option to set that.
It's possible to add that into sway ? Or into wlroots ?
comments:
libinput does give us relative coordinates for tablet events, but sway isn't hooked up to use it.

https://github.com/swaywm/sway/blob/master/sway/input/cursor.c#L440-L469
(`struct wlr_event_tablet_tool_axis` has that `dx` and `dy` as a member).

I'll admit that the input code would be the part I'm the least familiar with, but I don't think it would be that hard for someone to add support for that.

I'm not a good dev, and I don't know how i can add my modification in a good way. I want to add an option similar to `option "Mode Relative"`(from X libinput configuration) into main sway configuration file; so users can choose between relative and absolute input.
Do you have any idea how I can create that ?

review_comments:
Hmm, the kernel style says this in section 14 ([link](https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/process/coding-style.rst)):

> The preferred form for passing a size of a struct is the following:
>
 >     p = kmalloc(sizeof(*p), ...);
>
> The alternative form where struct name is spelled out hurts readability and
> introduces an opportunity for a bug when the pointer variable type is changed
> but the corresponding sizeof that is passed to a memory allocator is not.

This makes sense to me. While I can change this code to use `sizeof(struct input_config_tool)` etc. instead, in that case I think the divergence from the kernel style should be documented as part of CONTRIBUTING.md alongside other divergences.

I personally don't have any strong opinion one way or the other, but I do value consistency. Since we do use the `sizeof(struct input_config_tool)` style throughout the codebase, I'd rather continue with that. I can submit a PR tomorrow to add a note to CONTRIBUTING,md with this divergence.
